chunks.name: kind_weight_work
chunks.doc: ⚖️ Kind weight work: the staged edit of the brush kind weights, the catalog, its validation, the sum of the other weights and the rebuilt publication.

chunks.name: add_object_kind_work
chunks.doc: ➕️ Add object kind work: the staged addition of one object kind, decoded and checked against the catalog, with its representation and vortex, then published.

chunks.name: patch_inspector_work
chunks.doc: 🔍️ Patch inspector work: the staged inspector patch that pages through the selected objects, vortices, attractions, references and target volumes.

chunks.name: create_attraction_work
chunks.doc: 💞️ Create attraction work: the staged creation of one attraction, its existing attractions, the two endpoints and their compatibility, with the relocation page size.

chunks.name: set_active_example_work
chunks.doc: 📚️ Set active example work: the staged switch of the active example document in fixed steps and bounded chunks.
